name: 气动维护（排水/加油/检修）周期

map.⏱️ 气动系统维护周期: ⏱️ Pneumatic Maintenance Cycle Planner (Drain / Oil / Service)
map.登记气动元件维护周期，设置上次维护日期，自动计算到期日并按优先级排程。: Plan drain, lubrication and service cycles for pneumatic components by element type and cycle length, generated as a maintenance calendar with due-date reminders.
map.维护周期参考：过滤器每日排水、油雾器每周加油、阀岛每月检查、气缸每季度检修、空压: Cycle reference: filter daily drain, lubricator weekly oil, valve terminal monthly check, cylinder quarterly service, compressor semi-annual service, receiver weekly drain
map.下次维护日 = 上次维护日 + 周期；超过到期日为逾期，7 天内为临近到期: Next due = last date + cycle; past due = overdue, within 7 days = near due
map.完成任务后上次维护日期自动更新为今天，并重新计算排程: After completion, last date auto-updates to today and reschedules
map.按元件类型（过滤器、油雾器、干燥机、储气罐等）设维护周期，自动推算下次到期日期。: Set cycles by component type (filter, lubricator, dryer, receiver) and auto-compute next due date.
map.计划式维护：生成维护日历，汇总已到期与临近到期项，安排停机与备件采购。: Planned maintenance: generate a calendar, summarize due and near-due items, plan downtime and spares.
map.台账登记：记录上次维护日期与元件编号，多人共用设备时避免漏保养。: Ledger: record last date and component ID to avoid missed care on shared equipment.
map.空气过滤器维护周期 30 天、上次维护 9 月 1 日，则下次到期 10 月 1: Air filter cycle 30 days, last Sep 1 → due Oct 1; lubricator oil cycle 15 days, last Sep 1 → due Sep 16. As of Sep 13, lubricator is due in 3 days and should enter this week plan.
map.参考厂家手册并结合工况：粉尘、潮湿环境应缩短过滤器与排水周期；油雾器按耗油量与用: Follow the manual and duty: dusty/humid environments shorten filter and drain cycles; lubricator oil by consumption and air use; receiver drain by condensate.
map.元件台账与维护记录存于浏览器本地存储（localStorage），不上传服务器；: The ledger and records are in browser localStorage, not uploaded; clearing browser data erases them — export or back up periodically.
map.不会。本工具为纯前端运行，需打开页面查看维护日历与到期清单；建议纳入日常巡检流程: No. It runs client-side; open the page to see the calendar and due list. Include it in routine inspection.
map.面向气动系统点检维保的计划工具，内置常见元件维护周期模板，按上次维护日期自动排程: A planning tool for pneumatic inspection/maintenance, with built-in common-element cycle templates, auto-scheduling from last date, prioritizing overdue and near-due tasks.
